Xerath

the Magus Ascendant
Mid laneSupport lane

Xerath is a long-range artillery mage who bombards enemies from huge distances. He has a stun, a slow and an ultimate that fires several shots from across the map. He's immobile, so positioning is everything. Pick him if you love landing skill shots and poking enemies from far away.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Xerath

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Not ideal. He's immobile, so assassins and divers can kill him easily. Better to pick him after seeing the enemy mid.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages he can out-range, like Viktor and Syndra
  • Teams without much engage or dive
  • Teams with slow, tanky champions he can poke
  • Siege games where poke matters

Avoid into

  • Assassins who can dodge or reach him, like Fizz and Ekko
  • Teams with lots of engage
  • Champions who can dive past his frontline
  • Teams with lots of healing

Great teammates

MalphiteHis ultimate locks enemies in place for your combo.
SejuaniHer crowd control makes your skill shots easy to land.
OrnnHe protects you and sets up your combo with his ultimate.

Your team needs: Pick Xerath when your team has a strong frontline to protect him.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Huge range: he can poke enemies before they can touch him
  • Strong wave clear and siege with Arcanopulse
  • Rite of the Arcane hits enemies from extreme distance, great for finishing low targets
  • Shocking Orb stuns for longer the farther it travels

Weaknesses

  • Immobile: no dash, so assassins and divers kill him easily
  • All his damage comes from skill shots, so missing them wastes your damage
  • Weak if the enemy can reach him or catch him with crowd control
  • Needs his team to protect him

Power spikes

  • Level 3: Q, W and E unlocked. You can poke the enemy hard.
  • Level 6: Rite of the Arcane lets you finish low enemies from far away.
  • First item (Luden's Echo): more burst and mana. Your poke hurts a lot.
  • Two items (Shadowflame): your combo kills squishy champions.
  • Three items (Rabadon's Deathcap): huge damage from very far away.

Top tips

  • Charge Q from out of range, then step forward to fire.
  • Shocking Orb stuns longer when it travels farther. Use it from max range when possible.
  • Always save E for when an assassin dives you.
  • Auto-attack minions to trigger Mana Surge and save mana.
  • Check that no enemies are close before using your ultimate: you can't move while it's active.
  • Land W first, then Q on the slowed enemy for easy hits.
